prompts.name: fish_rack
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset for a cute historical Goryeo trading RPG. Match the provided approved market props: slightly overhead front-facing orthographic view, dark brown pixel outline, golden wood, cream cloth, flat 2-3 shade clusters, restrained teal accents, clean large shapes and readable goods. Genuine transparent background, single complete isolated object with margin, no ground, no people, no text, no perspective vanishing point, no gradients or blur. Create a wide low wooden fish-drying rack, no canopy. Two simple horizontal wood rails on sturdy short posts, several recognizable silvery fish with tapered tails hanging in a neat spaced row, subtle rope ties. A compact port market drying stand. Wide 3:2 silhouette, final native target 48x32 pixels. Fish must read clearly after reduction, avoid tiny scales or busy texture. Same width and overall low height as reference counter, full object.
